description: List every astrology tool with its price, input schema and an example request. Free; call it first to pick the right tool.
name: astro_catalog

accuracy.description: Headline of the accuracy benchmark against NASA/JPL Horizons (largest deviations in arcseconds) with links to the details.

discovery.description: Discovery documents: OpenAPI, MCP server card, A2A agent card.

free_endpoints.description: Endpoints that are always free (catalog, verify, health, benchmark).

payment.description: Free calls, payment protocols (x402, MPP) and networks.

premium.description: The full-chart tools, same fields as 'calls'.

start_here.description: Which tool to call first for common questions.

whats_new.description: What the current release added (version, date, and each new tool or proof with its route, price and summary).

why_use_this_instead_of_computing_it_you.description: Reasons to prefer these tools over computing a chart yourself.
